reason: The 'no effect' conclusion rests on an unjustified north-only subsample (N=633), which leaves the estimate too imprecise to rule out an effect. On the full sample (N=2000) with the same controls, training_hours has a positive, significant coefficient of about 0.58 (SE 0.23, p=0.012). The north-region SE (0.40) is wide enough to include that value, so the data don't show absence of an effect.
